comparison.objective: Fit and hand-tighten an oxygen regulator on a cylinder valve; candidate separates media from finished parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Yoke alignment, pin insertion, gasket seating, and screw tightening versus bimanual pouring, agitation, and aperture-mediated flow.
comparison.success_condition: Regulator seated, aligned, torque-qualified, released and still without drop/tip events versus media recovery and washer-retention thresholds with no spill/damage.
comparison.reason: Precision mechanical installation is distinct from bulk dry separation.
